table.TOO_LARGE_ONE: A message sent to this channel was too large to read (over 1 MB with its attachments) and was set aside: nothing was done with it. If it was yours, send smaller files: about 700 KB in all at most.
table.TOO_LARGE_MANY: {n} messages sent to this channel were too large to read (over 1 MB with their attachments) and were set aside: nothing was done with them. If one was yours, send smaller files: about 700 KB in all at most.
